prompt: Create only the BOTTOM principal view of this mossy coral-stone ruin arch, looking straight upward along the vertical axis, orthographic and axis-aligned. Preserve the arch structure footprint as an open U-shaped masonry ring/underside: two distinct square stone feet at the near end, two side piers, and only the shallow narrow underside of the arch band at the far end. The central doorway must remain a large open transparent gap; absolutely no solid slab, tray, or filled panel between the feet. Remove flowers and leaves from the underside, use believable plain rough gray-green stone blocks with the same moss color. Match the same object width/depth and stone block pattern family; no extra pillars or changed shape. Full object centered on transparent 256x256, no perspective. Inferred underside, not recovered pixels or calibrated 3D.

reference_inputs.role: source plus current six; correct bottom only

geometry_constraints: U-shaped masonry footprint, not filled square
two separate near stone feet and side piers
narrow shallow far arch underside only
